# Cloud and infrastructure

## Scope

Applies when the change touches IaC, containers, Kubernetes, functions, CI/CD, or cloud cost. Not when the change only reads configuration the platform already provides. Neighbours: `aidd-team:ci-pipeline`, `aidd-team:release-rollout`, `aidd-team:enterprise-controls`.

## Standards

| # | Standard | Edition |
| --- | --- | --- |
| S1 | AWS Well-Architected Framework | 2024-11-06 update |
| S2 | Google Cloud Well-Architected Framework | 2026-01-28 review |

## Checklist by loop step

| Step | Item | Standard |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Entry (`aidd assess`) | CI/CD files are protected paths (major, the security pool); IaC, containers, and Kubernetes manifests are baseline rules (normal) unless a dimension, a risk rule, or a protected path raises them. | S1 |
| Specify | The plan or dry-run output is part of the Acceptance; blast radius and rollback (previous version, previous state) are named. | S1 |
| Specify | A stateful service (database, bucket, queue holding data) states its RTO and RPO, and has a restore runbook (`restore = true`, `rto`, `rpo`). A person runs it as a restore drill from real backups into a scratch environment. `aidd doctor` warns when `tested_on` passes `runbook_max_age_days`. | S1, S2 |
| Specify | Placement (functions, containers, VMs, edge) chosen with references/cost-and-performance.md. A monthly estimate at today's load and at 10x, in the Context or the tech spec's Scale and cost row, within `[project.budget]`. `aidd validate` warns on none, or one over `max_infra_per_month`. | S1, S2, S3, S4 |
| Implement | Least privilege on every identity; no long-lived secret (OIDC); images pinned by digest; actions pinned by commit SHA. | S5, S6 |
| Implement | Allocation tags (environment, service, owner) on every resource. Where the IaC defines cloud resources: a budget with an alert per environment, and non-production that scales to zero. A concurrency or instance cap on every function and autoscaler, and pooled database connections. | S4, S1 |
| Review | The plan matches the Spec: no resource deleted or replaced, and no cost increase, that the Spec did not name. | S8, S4 |
| Ship | Progressive rollout (canary or blue-green), rolled back automatically on the SLO, where the hosting supports it (otherwise the rollback runbook). A drift check after apply, and actual cost by tag against the estimate in the observe window; an unexplained gap is a Learn action. | S1, S4 |

## Test commands

| Command | Proves | How | Standard |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| IaC scanning | no high finding in the infrastructure code | `uvx checkov==3.3.20 -d .`, Trivy config (v0.74.0), or KICS | S5 |
| Policy as code | the plan or manifests pass the policies | `conftest test` (Conftest v0.71.1, OPA policies), or Kyverno | S8 |
| Manifest lint | Pod Security Standards and best practices hold | `kube-linter lint .` (kube-linter v0.8.3) or Polaris | S6, S7 |
| Plan or dry-run check | no resource is destroyed or replaced that the Spec did not name | a script over `terraform show -json`, `pulumi preview --json` (Pulumi v3.265.0), `npx aws-cdk@2.1143.0 diff --fail`, or `npx wrangler@4.148.0 deploy --dry-run` failing on an unnamed destroy or replace; the plan attached for the Approver | S1, S3 |
| Cost diff threshold | the cost change is what the Spec states; the total is within `max_infra_per_month` | Optional: the `cost-estimate-tool` or a monthly estimate from the provider's calculator, recorded in the Spec. Infracost CLI v2.17.0 (`infracost auth login`): `scan <dir> --json` on base and head, a script failing when `summary.total_monthly_cost` passes the Spec's change or its limit. It sends resource parameters to Infracost's pricing API, or a self-hosted `INFRACOST_CLI_PRICING_ENDPOINT` | S4 |
| Tag and budget policy | every resource has the allocation tags; each environment, a budget with an alert | Where the IaC is Terraform or OpenTofu: the `policy-tool`, default Conftest (v0.71.1), over `terraform show -json`: deny an untagged resource and an environment without a budget | S4, S8 |

- From `aidd-team:enterprise-controls`: Container scan and SBOM.
